payload.text: (vc, 2026-11-10, under hv's pen; open to hv's reversal) ST0091 WP-03 IS RESHAPED, on dc's findings F9 and F10 against the vendored devbin 0.1.20 core, which vc checked in lib/resolve and lib/cmd/macos. The built-in macOS publish is not adopted in 3.3.0: a project handler shadows a built-in of the same name whole, the built-in ships other assets than the four Intent's formula and kegs depend on, and the core signs before the tag, so what it signs reads dev. Intent keeps cmd/macos, its asset names and its packaging. release.formula stays false, and the cut publishes through one after: command that stops at its first failure and is safe to run again at the tag: build the pair at the tag, macos prepare with F1's refusal, macos publish, then the built-in formula publish; the brew smoke follows. It stops because a tap ahead of its assets breaks brew upgrade for every user. AC-03.1 and AC-03.2, the thread objective's item 3 and WP-03's body carry the shape. The built-in macOS publish waits on a devbin that stages after the tag and ships several named assets; dc drafts the devbin issue. The same day: issue 0672 is narrowed to the devbin-or-none shape and declared commands are issue 0678, not built, for hv to place; issue 0677 is its Intent-owned part alone, and the change to the shared catalogue's FMT-02 set belongs to llm-tropes and is parked for hv; issues 0665 and 0649 moved from dc to cc, and 0665's class is shown and never counted.
